head_commit.message:
Link Windows releases with LLD

Four recent x64 release builds spent about 36.5 minutes between
the last source crate starting and Cargo completing. That final phase
contains LLVM code generation and MSVC linking, accounting for most of
each 48-minute build.

Use the existing MSVC setup action to select the bundled LLD. Current
Windows ARM64 archive CI exercises the action and its LLD wrapper.

Code generation remains. Replaying the latest release timeline, macOS
becomes critical after roughly four minutes of Windows improvement, so
estimate a four-minute reduction in total workflow runtime. A live
release run can replace that estimate with a measured result.
